summary: Exact-head source audit of PR #327 found that represented-count equality alone does not prove Workspace representation-set integrity. A missing direct child can be replaced one-for-one by a stale/duplicate entity child while preserving UNRENDERED_RepresentedCount. The shared diagnostics enumeration should additionally require unique WorldEntityIds and lab.isRepresented(id) for every enumerated child before capture/readout publication.
evidence: PhysicsLabRealizer.isRepresented(id) checks the runtime-owned representation map and authoritative F0/F2 fidelity boundary rather than scanning Workspace children.

Current PR #327 directRepresentations() compares only #representations to UNRENDERED_RepresentedCount; capture/preflight later call getRecord(id), which can resolve an F0 entity or a duplicated represented id without proving the enumerated physical child belongs to the authoritative representation set.
Count equality plus unique enumerated ids plus isRepresented(id) membership forms a bounded set-integrity fence without exposing the private representation map or making Workspace canonical.
